build_MCInterpreter: build a Minecraft interpreter that processes chat commands and pushes build, destroy, spawn, fill, dig, dance, modify, and get tasks onto the agent task stack
handle_build_MCInterpreter: handle a BUILD command by interpreting schematics or reference objects and pushing Build tasks to the agent stack
handle_destroy_MCInterpreter: handle a DESTROY command by finding destructible objects and pushing Destroy tasks to the agent stack
handle_modify_MCInterpreter: handle a MODIFY command to thicken, replace, scale, or fill voxel objects by pushing Build and Destroy tasks
handle_spawn_MCInterpreter: handle a SPAWN command by interpreting mob schematics and pushing Spawn tasks at resolved locations
